## gitshift auto default

Show or set the account used when no rule matches

### Synopsis

Show or set the account auto-switch uses outside every rule directory.

Without a default, leaving rule directories keeps the current identity.

```
gitshift auto default [ALIAS] [flags]
```

### Examples

```
  gitshift auto default work
  gitshift auto default
  gitshift auto default --clear
```

### Options

```
      --clear   remove the default account
  -h, --help    help for default
```

### Options inherited from parent commands

```
      --config string   config file (default is $HOME/.config/gitshift/config.yaml)
```
